svg.title: TheRock artifact cache — current design at f7cd03db8
svg.desc: A one-page design of the implemented local artifact bundle cache. CMake generates fingerprints, Python forms ArtifactKey objects, SQLite supplies metadata candidates, and stored files are verified. A cacheable miss invokes the default incremental build. Copies are saved and validated before complete ready entries are committed. Configured dependency reporting explains impact without selecting build targets. Repository-wide commit invalidation remains deferred.
